mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers a risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) and an increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a contraction in housing demand and rising cost pressures, which together cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS increases over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0 in a 3-month window, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0 in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 137,000.0 signals a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS < 137000.0, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDP growth rate > 3.0% and housing starts > 1000.0), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines in the context of GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% and HOUST > 1000.0, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
